name: Eurohold Bulgaria AD
summary: Eurohold Bulgaria AD engages in the energy business in Bulgaria, North Macedonia, Greece, Romania, Belarus, Georgia, Ukraine, Spain, Italy, Poland, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands. It operates through Energy, Insurance, and Financial Services segments.
